svg.aria-label: Decay of six indicator profiles over 120 days, computed by the ONYX decay engine
svg.text: How fast does an indicator lose value?
Freshness score over 120 days for six indicator profiles. Values from onyx-core decay_engine.calculate_decay, not hand-drawn.
Dashed line: score 0.5. A hash decays slowly by design (it stays useful for forensics); a criminal-hosted IP is recycled within days.
